inputs.prompt: A concept artist sketchbook page of prop exploration for a dark fantasy video game: twelve rough concept sketches of the pod of an alien who upgrades fighters, where a fighter steps in plain and steps out wearing new regalia, laid out in a grid of four columns and three rows on white paper, each sketch numbered with a big hand written number from 1 to 12. Loose confident pencil lines with grey marker shading and a quick wash of pearl white with lilac shadows, rose gold and plum. Every sketch shows the whole object in a three quarter view standing on bare sand, each a genuinely different idea, all made by one alien civilisation from pearly opalescent scaled shell, plum cloth printed with a starfield, rose gold trims and dark gunmetal with glowing orange glyph seams. Every one shows the moment of change, a plain figure going in or a crowned figure coming out. No flat window. The twelve ideas: 1 an upright pearly egg that opens like petals around a figure wrapped in light. 2 a rose gold archway, a plain figure walking in one side and a crowned one out the other. 3 a chrysalis hanging from a rose gold hook with a figure curled inside. 4 a tall standing mirror of liquid pearl that a figure steps into. 5 a plinth with pieces of regalia, a crown, shoulder plates and a cloak, orbiting above it. 6 an upright shell sarcophagus with a window of plum starfield cloth. 7 a mannequin frame of rose gold wire with cloth weaving itself around it. 8 a bud of shell petals on a stem opening to show the finished figure. 9 a basin of pearl liquid that a figure rises out of. 10 a cage of curved shell ribs closing around a figure like a corset. 11 a vertical loom weaving regalia onto a body of light. 12 a spiral nautilus shell that a figure walks into and comes out of changed. Short hand written notes and arrows beside some sketches. Clean white paper, no frame, no other text.
